scenes.title: Every retirement plan assumes nothing goes wrong.
scenes.say: Every retirement plan assumes nothing goes wrong. Real life doesn't work like that.

scenes.title: 🌪️ Chaos mode
scenes.say: Chaos mode rolls realistic life events onto your projection. Surgery, a new baby, a layoff, a windfall. Thirty-seven events in eight categories, each with real odds for your age.

scenes.title: Every marker explains itself.
scenes.say: Hover any marker to see what happened, what led to it, and what it cost. Events chain together: a parent's care, then a funeral, then an inherited house.

scenes.title: A whole life, in one timeline.
scenes.say: Every event lands in a timeline that follows the chart window. Costs that outrun inflation, like medical bills and rent, keep climbing. Don't like this life? Reroll it.

scenes.title: 🛡️ Mitigate the hits.
scenes.say: Then tick the coverage you already have: pet insurance, an HSA, disability, umbrella liability. Chaos applies it, charges the premium every year, and shows what it saved.

scenes.title: On your phone, too.
scenes.say: And it all works on your phone, chaos included, with the same life on every screen.

scenes.title: Plan for the life you'll actually live.
scenes.say: fire. Plan for the life you'll actually live. Try it at lifefire dot netlify dot app.
